content.short: Stripe Crypto provides a regulated, embeddable fiat-to-crypto onramp for Web3 applications and wallets.
content.description:
Stripe Crypto is a professional-grade fiat-to-crypto payment service designed by the global payments leader to simplify the onboarding process for decentralized applications. The platform offers an embeddable and customizable onramp widget that allows users to instantly purchase digital assets—including ETH, SOL, and USDC—using traditional payment methods such as credit cards, Apple Pay, and ACH. Stripe handles the entire end-to-end flow, including KYC verification, fraud prevention, and regulatory compliance, acting as the merchant of record for all transactions.

Operating across major blockchain networks like Ethereum, Polygon, and Solana, Stripe Crypto provides a seamless and secure bridge between traditional banking rails and the decentralized economy. Developers can integrate the service with minimal code, enabling their users to interact with Web3 protocols without the typical friction of external exchanges. Through its commitment to regulatory alignment and user-centric design, Stripe is building the essential infrastructure needed for mass adoption, making digital asset ownership as intuitive as any traditional online payment.
content.meta: Stripe Crypto offers a secure, embeddable fiat-onramp for Web3 apps, handling KYC and compliance for instant crypto purchases.
